findings.title: Delayed drag-to-close pop is not idempotent: a tap or Escape within 200 ms closes two screens
findings.scoreReason: The stacked backdrop is a transparent full-screen layer, and the delayed setTimeout(onClose, 200) calls the now non-idempotent fileViewerBack a second time, so a tap or Escape inside the window closes the list too; the window is only 200 ms after a drag, and the guard is one line.

findings.title: Pass inert as a JSX attribute instead of a ref effect (Preact 11 types declare it)
findings.scoreReason: Preact's dom.d.ts declares inert, but the effect only leaves the covered sheet non-inert for one frame: a one-line simplification with no defect for a user.

findings.title: Return focus to the list item that opened the diff when going back
findings.scoreReason: A real gap for keyboard users that was there before this change, and now cheap to fix because the list stays mounted; worth a line in the review comment, not a regression or a work item.
